sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Player at r16-19, c38-41
# Upper creature at r12-21, c14-27
# Continue LEFT to approach upper creature

action(['LEFT', 'LEFT', 'LEFT', 'LEFT'], intent='solve')

seg = current_frame.segmentation
player = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'p'][0]
pb = player['boundary']
prows = [p[0] for p in pb]
pcols = [p[1] for p in pb]
print(f"Player: r{min(prows)}-{max(prows)}, c{min(pcols)}-{max(pcols)}")

# Check M block
M_blocks = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'M']
for m in M_blocks:
    b = m['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in b]
    cols = [p[1] for p in b]
    print(f"M: r{min(rows)}-{max(rows)}, c{min(cols)}-{max(cols)}")

# Check bottom bar
print("\nBottom bar:")
for n in seg['nodes']:
    b = n['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in b]
    if min(rows) >= 60:
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        print(f"  {n['color']}: c{min(cols)}-{max(cols)}")

# Check adjacencies
adj = seg['adjacency_list']
player_adj = [pair for pair in adj if player['id'] in pair]
for pair in player_adj:
    other_id = pair[0] if pair[1] == player['id'] else pair[1]
    other = seg['nodes'][other_id]
    if other['color'] != 'b':
        b = other['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        print(f"  Adjacent: {other['color']}, r{min(rows)}-{max(rows)}, c{min(cols)}-{max(cols)}")

print(f"\nLevel completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed', False)}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
